entries.title: A card's thread on your iPhone keeps its newest answer in view
entries.body: On your iPhone, a first mate answer in a card's thread could slip under the card's lower edge when the message box below grew to show the same answer. A thread you are reading at its end now stays at its end.
entries.noPicture: The thread looks as it did; only an answer that was hidden under the card's edge now stays in view.
